name: brand_analytics_list_user_intent_clusters
description:
Lists semantic intent clusters defined for a company, with rolled-up search-term counts and average confidence from search_term_to_intent.

Returns the latest version of each (company_id, intent_id) — newer rows shadow older ones in the dedup CTE. Filter by status (active | archived | merged | all). Paginate with limit/offset.

Workflow position: STEP 2 (coverage check) and STEP 5 (verification) of the intent-clustering flow.
  - Pipeline: brand_analytics_analyze_search_query_performance → THIS TOOL (coverage diff) → brand_analytics_cluster_search_terms (uncovered only) → brand_analytics_create_user_intent_cluster (per proposed intent) → THIS TOOL (verify).
  - Pass optional `search_terms` to get a {covered, uncovered} diff in one round-trip; only the `uncovered` list should be sent to brand_analytics_cluster_search_terms.

intent_ids.description: Optional: filter to specific intent_id slugs.

search_terms.description: Optional. When provided, the response includes a `coverage` block listing which terms are already mapped to intents (and which are not). Use the uncovered list as input to brand_analytics_cluster_search_terms.

coverage.description: Only present when `search_terms` is supplied in the request.
